identity.title: [v0.92][WP-02] Agent Logic GitHub organization repository migration

values.summary: Verify organization gates, transfer exactly five repositories serially with assignee-aware manifests and zero unexplained drift, execute the ADL website/integration cutover last, prove exclusions, and retain a reviewed final report.

steps.action: Verify organization readiness, plan lineage, exact five-repository scope, and per-repository assignee-aware manifests
Transfer and independently verify each of the five destination repositories serially, stopping on any unexplained drift
Complete the exact agent-logic.ai production and beta cutover, both negative controls, final report, validator, and exact-revision review

affected_areas: GitHub repository ownership and organization policy
Issues, pull requests, assignees, teams, collaborators, and rulesets
Actions, environments, OIDC, packages, LFS, Pages, webhooks, Apps, and deploy keys
Current repository URLs, clone remotes, badges, sites, and external consumers
invariants: Transfer one repository at a time and pass verification before continuing
Preserve repository name, visibility, default branch, and exact history
Record secret names and scopes only, never values
Use redirects only as temporary compatibility
asksifu remains personal and Horust is untouched
risks: Assignee loses eligibility after organization transfer
Packages, OIDC, Pages, or integrations retain old-owner coupling
Fork-network or destination-name conflict blocks transfer
Transfer-back fails to restore organization-owned settings
Concurrent publication changes the manifest during a window
stop_conditions: WP-01B or #5815 plan lineage is not current
Destination owner, billing, recovery, or security gate is incomplete
An assignee lacks membership and an approved reassignment plan
Any transferred repository fails Gate 4 verification
A secret value appears in retained evidence
replan_triggers: GitHub changes transfer, package, Pages, or organization-policy behavior
A destination repository or fork-network conflict appears
A critical external integration cannot support a same-window cutover
Transfer-back becomes the organization-owner recovery decision
